narrative_passages.title: The pledge under the tree
narrative_passages.treatment_reason: The pledge is read under the tree; no one is shown.

summary_for_children: Al-Fath means The Victory. It speaks of the believers' pledge under a tree, of tranquillity Allah sent to their hearts, and compares them to a seed that grows strong.
environment_concept: A single tree on a plain, no one shown (48:18), and a shoot growing strong on its stalk (48:29).
architecture_and_scenery: Open plain, a single tree, a field of crops whose shoots grow stronger.

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A road through dry hills to a long wall with a closed gate, with a broad tree before it

primary_mechanic.text: The gate does not open for pushing. Wait still in the circle before it while three provocations come; each can be met calmly or with pushing, which sets the waiting back. The gate opens only to calm patience (48:24-26). The gate is a game idea; no one is shown.

secondary_activities: the pledge under the tree (48:18, read)
like a plant growing strong (48:29, read)
unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading under the tree, the wait at the gate, then readings along the road beyond it
environment_behaviour: the waiting circle fills as calm builds
the circle flickers when something provocative happens
the gate swings open when calm is complete
unique_world.learning_objective: Learn that calm and holding back opened the way (48:24-26)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Victory of Peace
story_library.children_narration: Sometimes a difficult agreement can lead to a good outcome. Surah Al-Fath speaks about a clear victory associated with the events of Hudaybiyyah. It reminds believers of trust, patience, commitment, and the importance of following guidance.

world_idea.title: The Road to Hudaybiyyah
world_idea.description: Explore a historical route and a peaceful agreement setting. Use a child-friendly decision activity to learn why resolving conflict can require patience and restraint.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
story_library.rule_conflicts_resolved: Hudaybiyyah has no people shown; the route is a landscape. No re-enactment.
